title: Lens Space Surgeries and the Bleiler-Litherland Conjecture
summary: We prove the Bleiler-Litherland conjecture: every lens space obtained by a nontrivial Dehn surgery on a hyperbolic knot in $S^3$ has order at least 18. The key ingredient is a spectral obstruction: if a hyperbolic knot $K$ of genus $g$ admits a lens space surgery with slope $\pm(4g-2)$, then $Δ_K(t)$ has a real root outside the unit circle. The proof combines Floer-theoretic restrictions on lens space surgeries, Gabai's degeneracy-slope bound and Gabai-Oertel's persistence theorem for essential laminations, Ni's fixed-point theorem for monodromy, and a mod-2 orientability criterion, together…
